body.en: Quadratics introduce curvature. Their U-shaped graphs — parabolas — appear in projectile motion, optimization, and a large share of every standardized test.
body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (الدوال والمعادلات التربيعية):

Quadratics introduce curvature. Their U-shaped graphs — parabolas — appear in projectile motion, optimization, and a large share of every standardized test.

body.en: A quadratic function has the form \( f(x)=ax^2+bx+c \) with \( a\neq 0 \). Its graph is a parabola opening upward when a>0 and downward when a<0 , with axis of symmetry \( x=-\dfrac{b}{2a} \).
body.ar: A quadratic الدالة has the form \( f(x)=ax^2+bx+c \) with \( a\neq 0 \). Its التمثيل البياني is a القطع المكافئ opening upward عندما a>0 and downward عندما a<0 , with axis of symmetry \( x=-\dfrac{b}{2a} \).

body.en:
The solutions of \( ax^2+bx+c=0 \) are

\[ x=\frac{-b\pm\sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}. \]

The discriminant \( \Delta=b^2-4ac \) reveals the roots: \Delta>0 gives two real roots, \( \Delta=0 \) one repeated root, and \Delta<0 no real roots.

The discriminant \( \Delta=b^2-4ac \) reveals the roots: \Delta>0 gives two real roots, \( \Delta=0 \) one repeated root, and \Delta<0 no real roots.

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Quadratic Functions)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (Quadratic الدوال)

body.en:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the range to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the المدى to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).

body.en:
Solve \( x^2-5x+6=0 \).

Find two numbers multiplying to \( 6 \) and adding to \( -5 \): namely \( -2 \) and \( -3 \).

\[ (x-2)(x-3)=0 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad x=2 \ \text{or}\ x=3. \]

الشرح الرياضي (الدوال والمعادلات التربيعية):

Solve \( 2x^2+3x-2=0 \).

Here \( a=2,\ b=3,\ c=-2 \), so \( \Delta=9+16=25 \):

\[ x=\frac{-3\pm\sqrt{25}}{4}=\frac{-3\pm 5}{4}=\tfrac12 \ \text{or}\ -2. \]

label.en: ⚠ Common traps — Vertex sign errors & the square root property
label.ar: ⚠ Common traps — الرأس sign errors & the square root property

body.en:
Vertex form sign: In \( f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k \), the vertex is at \( (h, k) \), not \( (-h, k) \). For example, \( f(x) = (x - 3)^2 + 5 \) has its vertex at \( (3, 5) \), whereas \( f(x) = (x + 3)^2 + 5 \) has its vertex at \( (-3, 5) \).

Plus-or-minus roots: When solving \( (x - h)^2 = d \), always include both roots: \( x - h = \pm\sqrt{d} \). Omitting the negative root loses half of the solution set.

Squaring negative coefficients in \( b^2 - 4ac \): When \( b \) is negative, \( b^2 \) is always positive: \( (-5)^2 = 25 \), not \( -25 \). A sign error here completely alters the discriminant.
body.ar:
Vertex form sign: In \( f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k \), the الرأس is at \( (h, k) \), not \( (-h, k) \). For example, \( f(x) = (x - 3)^2 + 5 \) has its الرأس at \( (3, 5) \), whereas \( f(x) = (x + 3)^2 + 5 \) has its الرأس at \( (-3, 5) \).

Plus-or-minus roots: عندما solving \( (x - h)^2 = d \), always include both roots: \( x - h = \pm\sqrt{d} \). Omitting the negative root loses half of the الحل set.

Squaring negative المعاملات in \( b^2 - 4ac \): عندما \( b \) is negative, \( b^2 \) is always positive: \( (-5)^2 = 25 \), not \( -25 \). A sign error here completely alters the discriminant.

body.en:
Problem (Medium): In the figure below, triangle \(ABC\) is a right triangle with right angle at \(C\), and altitude \(CD\) is drawn to hypotenuse \(AB\). The length of altitude \(CD\) is \(6\), \(AD = x\), and \(DB = x + 5\). What is the length of hypotenuse \(AB\)?

Step-by-Step Solution: By the Geometric Mean Theorem (Altitude Rule) for right triangles, the altitude to the hypotenuse is the geometric mean of the two segments of the hypotenuse: \(CD^2 = AD \cdot DB\) Substitute the given values into the equation: \(6^2 = x(x + 5)\) \(36 = x^2 + 5x\) Rearrange into standard quadratic form: \(x^2 + 5x - 36 = 0\) Factor the quadratic equation: \((x + 9)(x - 4) = 0\) This gives two solutions: \(x = -9\) and \(x = 4\). Because \(AD = x\) represents a geometric length, it must be positive. Thus, we reject the extraneous negative root \(x = -9\), which leaves \(x = 4\). Finally, calculate the length of hypotenuse \(AB\): \(AB = AD + DB = x + (x + 5) = 4 + (4 + 5) = 4 + 9 = 13\). Common traps: - Choice A (\(4\)) is an incomplete solve trap: finding \(x\) but forgetting to compute the total hypotenuse \(AB\). - Choice B (\(9\)) only gives the segment \(DB\), or mistakenly takes the absolute value of the extraneous root \(-9\). - Choice D (\(17\)) typically arises from factoring or sign errors.
body.ar:
Problem (Medium): In the الشكل below, المثلث \(ABC\) is a right المثلث with right الزاوية at \(C\), and altitude \(CD\) is drawn to hypotenuse \(AB\). The length of altitude \(CD\) is \(6\), \(AD = x\), and \(DB = x + 5\). What is the length of hypotenuse \(AB\)?

Step-by-Step الحل: By the Geometric Mean مبرهنة (Altitude Rule) for right triangles, the altitude to the hypotenuse is the geometric mean of the two segments of the hypotenuse: \(CD^2 = AD \cdot DB\) عوّض the المعطيات values into the المعادلة: \(6^2 = x(x + 5)\) \(36 = x^2 + 5x\) Rearrange into standard quadratic form: \(x^2 + 5x - 36 = 0\) Factor the المعادلة التربيعية: \((x + 9)(x - 4) = 0\) This gives two الحلول: \(x = -9\) and \(x = 4\). Because \(AD = x\) represents a geometric length, it must be positive. وعليه, we reject the extraneous negative root \(x = -9\), which leaves \(x = 4\). Finally, احسب length of hypotenuse \(AB\): \(AB = AD + DB = x + (x + 5) = 4 + (4 + 5) = 4 + 9 = 13\). Common traps: - Choice A (\(4\)) is an incomplete solve trap: finding \(x\) but forgetting to compute the total hypotenuse \(AB\). - Choice B (\(9\)) only gives the segment \(DB\), or mistakenly takes the absolute value of the extraneous root \(-9\). - Choice D (\(17\)) typically arises from factoring or sign errors.

body.en:
Problem (Hard): In the figure, \(\triangle ABC\) is a right triangle with the right angle at vertex \(C\), and altitude \(CD\) is drawn perpendicular to the hypotenuse \(AB\). The lengths of the segments are given in terms of a variable \(x\) by \(AD = x + 2\), \(DB = 3x - 5\), and \(CD = x + 5\). What is the perimeter of \(\triangle ABC\)?

Step-by-Step Solution: We solve the problem through the following steps: 1. **Apply the Geometric Mean Theorem (Right-Triangle Altitude Theorem):** In a right triangle with an altitude drawn to the hypotenuse, the length of the altitude is the geometric mean of the two segments of the hypotenuse: \[ CD^2 = AD \cdot DB \] 2. **Formulate the quadratic equation:** Substitute the given algebraic expressions into the theorem: \[ (x + 5)^2 = (x + 2)(3x - 5) \] 3. **Expand and simplify to standard quadratic form:** \[ x^2 + 10x + 25 = 3x^2 + x - 10 \] Rearranging all terms to one side yields: \[ 2x^2 - 9x - 35 = 0 \] 4. **Factor and solve for \(x\):** \[ (2x + 5)(x - 7) = 0 \] This produces two candidate solutions: \(x = 7\) and \(x = -\frac{5}{2}\). 5. **Apply geometric domain constraints:** Every segment length must be strictly positive. Specifically, \(DB = 3x - 5 > 0\) requires \(x > \frac{5}{3}\). Therefore, the negative root \(x = -\frac{5}{2}\) is extraneous, leaving \(x = 7\) as the unique valid solution. 6. **Determine the lengths of the segments:** - \(AD = 7 + 2 = 9\) - \(DB = 3(7) - 5 = 16\) - \(CD = 7 + 5 = 12\) - Hypotenuse \(AB = AD + DB = 9 + 16 = 25\) 7. **Compute the legs \(AC\) and \(BC\):** Using the Pythagorean theorem in the smaller right triangles: - In \(\triangle ADC\): \(AC = \sqrt{AD^2 + CD^2} = \sqrt{9^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{81 + 144} = \sqrt{225} = 15\) - In \(\triangle BDC\): \(BC = \sqrt{DB^2 + CD^2} = \sqrt{16^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{256 + 144} = \sqrt{400} = 20\) 8. **Calculate the perimeter:** \[ \text{Perimeter} = AB + BC + AC = 25 + 20 + 15 = 60 \] **Analysis of Distractors:** - \(35\) is the sum of the two legs \(AC + BC = 15 + 20\), mistakenly omitting the hypotenuse \(AB\). - \(50\) arises from assuming an isosceles right triangle or doubling the hypotenuse. - \(150\) is the area of \(\triangle ABC\), \(\frac{1}{2} \cdot 25 \cdot 12 = 150\), confusing perimeter with area.
body.ar:
Problem (Hard): In the الشكل, \(\triangle ABC\) is a right المثلث with the right الزاوية at الرأس \(C\), and altitude \(CD\) is drawn perpendicular to the hypotenuse \(AB\). The lengths of the segments are المعطيات in terms of a المتغير \(x\) by \(AD = x + 2\), \(DB = 3x - 5\), and \(CD = x + 5\). What is the المحيط of \(\triangle ABC\)?

Step-by-Step الحل: We solve the problem through the following steps: 1. **Apply the Geometric Mean مبرهنة (Right-المثلث Altitude مبرهنة):** In a right المثلث with an altitude drawn to the hypotenuse, the length of the altitude is the geometric mean of the two segments of the hypotenuse: \[ CD^2 = AD \cdot DB \] 2. **Formulate the المعادلة التربيعية:** عوّض the المعطيات algebraic expressions into the المبرهنة: \[ (x + 5)^2 = (x + 2)(3x - 5) \] 3. **Expand and بسّط to standard quadratic form:** \[ x^2 + 10x + 25 = 3x^2 + x - 10 \] Rearranging all terms to one side yields: \[ 2x^2 - 9x - 35 = 0 \] 4. **Factor and أوجد قيمة \(x\):** \[ (2x + 5)(x - 7) = 0 \] This produces two candidate الحلول: \(x = 7\) and \(x = -\frac{5}{2}\). 5. **Apply geometric المجال constraints:** Every segment length must be strictly positive. Specifically, \(DB = 3x - 5 > 0\) requires \(x > \frac{5}{3}\). وبالتالي, the negative root \(x = -\frac{5}{2}\) is extraneous, leaving \(x = 7\) as the unique valid الحل. 6. **حدّد lengths of the segments:** - \(AD = 7 + 2 = 9\) - \(DB = 3(7) - 5 = 16\) - \(CD = 7 + 5 = 12\) - Hypotenuse \(AB = AD + DB = 9 + 16 = 25\) 7. **Compute the legs \(AC\) and \(BC\):** Using the Pythagorean المبرهنة in the smaller right triangles: - In \(\triangle ADC\): \(AC = \sqrt{AD^2 + CD^2} = \sqrt{9^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{81 + 144} = \sqrt{225} = 15\) - In \(\triangle BDC\): \(BC = \sqrt{DB^2 + CD^2} = \sqrt{16^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{256 + 144} = \sqrt{400} = 20\) 8. **احسب المحيط:** \[ \text{Perimeter} = AB + BC + AC = 25 + 20 + 15 = 60 \] **Analysis of Distractors:** - \(35\) is the sum of the two legs \(AC + BC = 15 + 20\), mistakenly omitting the hypotenuse \(AB\). - \(50\) arises from assuming an isosceles right المثلث or doubling the hypotenuse. - \(150\) is the المساحة of \(\triangle ABC\), \(\frac{1}{2} \cdot 25 \cdot 12 = 150\), confusing المحيط with المساحة.

question.en: A projectile is launched from ground level with height modelled by \( h(t) = -16t^2 + 64t + 80 \) feet after \( t \) seconds. Find (a) the maximum height reached, and (b) the time when it hits the ground.
question.ar: A projectile is launched from ground level with height modelled by \( h(t) = -16t^2 + 64t + 80 \) feet after \( t \) seconds. أوجد (a) the maximum height reached, and (b) the time عندما it hits the ground.

solution.en:
1. The maximum occurs at the vertex time \( t = -\dfrac{b}{2a} \):

\[ t = -\frac{64}{2(-16)} = \frac{64}{32} = 2\text{ seconds}. \]

Substitute \( t = 2 \) to get maximum height:

\[ h(2) = -16(2^2) + 64(2) + 80 = -64 + 128 + 80 = 144\text{ feet}. \]

2. Ground impact occurs when \( h(t) = 0 \):

\[ -16t^2 + 64t + 80 = 0 \implies t^2 - 4t - 5 = 0 \implies (t - 5)(t + 1) = 0. \]

Since time must be non-negative, \( t = 5 \) seconds.

question.en: Find all solutions to \(2x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0\) using the quadratic formula, and determine whether the roots are real or complex.
question.ar: أوجد all solutions to \(2x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0\) باستخدام quadratic formula, and حدّد whether the roots are real or complex.

solution.en:
Identify coefficients: \(a = 2\), \(b = -6\), \(c = 5\).

Evaluate the discriminant: \[\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = (-6)^2 - 4(2)(5) = 36 - 40 = -4.\] Because \(\Delta < 0\), the quadratic has two complex conjugate roots.

Apply the quadratic formula: \[x = \frac{-(-6) \pm \sqrt{-4}}{2(2)} = \frac{6 \pm 2i}{4} = \frac{3 \pm i}{2} = \frac{3}{2} \pm \frac{1}{2}i.\]

hints.en: The vertex form of a quadratic function is \( f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k \), where the point \( (h, k) \) represents the vertex of the parabola.

solution.en:
The vertex form of a quadratic function is \( f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k \), where the point \( (h, k) \) represents the vertex of the parabola.

Rewriting \( f(x) = (x + 3)^2 - 5 \) in this standard form:
\[ f(x) = (x - (-3))^2 + (-5) \]

From this expression, we identify:
- \( h = -3 \)
- \( k = -5 \)

Thus, the coordinates of the vertex are \( (-3, -5) \).

Common Misconceptions:
- \((3, -5)\): Incorrectly using \( +3 \) directly from the expression without accounting for the negative sign in \( (x - h) \).

solution.en:
The vertex form of a quadratic function is \(f(x) = a(x-h)^2 + k\), where \((h, k)\) is the vertex. \\
Given the vertex is \((1, 5)\), the function can be written as \(f(x) = a(x-1)^2 + 5\). \\
The graph also passes through the point \((3, -3)\). We can substitute these coordinates into the equation to solve for \(a\): \\
\(-3 = a(3-1)^2 + 5\) \\
\(-3 = a(2)^2 + 5\) \\
\(-3 = 4a + 5\) \\
Subtract 5 from both sides: \\
\(-3 - 5 = 4a\) \\
\(-8 = 4a\) \\
Divide by 4: \\
\(a = \frac{-8}{4}\) \\
\(a = -2\). \\

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
